migration.notes: No mandatory archive schema or Hub JSON migration. Source versions require native frozen-data and whole-state restore validation before release. Hermes reasoning cost is charged once; token buckets are preserved. Codex parser caches reparse once. Restore a complete closed pre-deployment state snapshot with its old image. Automatic rollback requires a NAS-local rehearsal receipt for this exact version and digest pair. Cross-v0.70 Hermes reasoning cost corrections require reviewed manual acceptance: production automatic controller remains fail-closed on any frozen cost difference. Synthetic manual-path receipts are not production receipts. Agent archive publication strictly rejects read/write errors and malformed rows before accepting usage. No accounting-rule or storage-format change from v0.71.0-01; frozen usage and cost must remain equal.
